title: Homer Simpson: An economic analysis
speaker: Vox
zh: 【Vox】荷馬辛普森：經濟分析（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In this 1995 episode of The Simpsons, Homer walks with Marge through downtown Springfield
cues.en: In this 1995 episode of The Simpsons, Homer walks with Marge through downtown Springfield
cues.zh: 在 1995 年的《辛普森一家》中，荷馬與瑪姬一起穿過斯普林菲爾德市中心

cues.text: and says Careful now.
cues.en: and says Careful now.
cues.zh: 並說現在要小心。

cues.text: These are dangerous streets for us upper-lower-middle-class types This is Homer’s first admission to being "middle-class"
cues.en: These are dangerous streets for us upper-lower-middle-class types This is Homer’s first admission to being "middle-class"
cues.zh: 對我們這些上層中下層階級來說，這些街道是危險的。這是荷馬第一次承認自己是“中產階級”

cues.text: For the rest of us, this always seemed obvious.
cues.en: For the rest of us, this always seemed obvious.
cues.zh: 對於我們其他人來說，這似乎總是顯而易見的。

cues.text: He lives in a modest home in the suburbs with his wife and three children.
cues.en: He lives in a modest home in the suburbs with his wife and three children.
cues.zh: 他與妻子和三個孩子住在郊區一棟簡陋的房子裡。

cues.text: He’s not a college graduate and his job appears to require a minimal amount of technical
cues.en: He’s not a college graduate and his job appears to require a minimal amount of technical
cues.zh: 他不是大學畢業生，他的工作似乎需要最少的技術

cues.text: training.
cues.en: training.
cues.zh: 訓練。

cues.text: This is all confirmed when we get a tight shot of his paycheck in season 7.
cues.en: This is all confirmed when we get a tight shot of his paycheck in season 7.
cues.zh: 當我們在第七季看到他的薪水時，這一切都得到了證實。

cues.text: Hey, how come my pay is so low?
cues.en: Hey, how come my pay is so low?
cues.zh: 哎呀，我的薪水怎麼這麼低？

cues.text: According to this stub, Homer receives a pre-tax, weekly pay of $479.60 works out to $11.99
cues.en: According to this stub, Homer receives a pre-tax, weekly pay of $479.60 works out to $11.99
cues.zh: 根據此存根，Homer 的稅前週薪為 479.60 美元，相當於 11.99 美元

cues.text: an hour.
cues.en: an hour.
cues.zh: 一個小時。

cues.text: So, he’s looking at an annual salary of $24,395.
cues.en: So, he’s looking at an annual salary of $24,395.
cues.zh: 因此，他期望的年薪為 24,395 美元。

cues.text: Adjusted for inflation, that’s $37,416 per year.
cues.en: Adjusted for inflation, that’s $37,416 per year.
cues.zh: 經通貨膨脹調整後，每年為 37,416 美元。

cues.text: What?
cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什麼？

cues.text: This is an outrage!
cues.en: This is an outrage!
cues.zh: 這是一種憤慨！

cues.text: There are a lot of fans who think the show is based on the real life town of Springfield,
cues.en: There are a lot of fans who think the show is based on the real life town of Springfield,
cues.zh: 有很多粉絲認為這部劇取材自現實生活中的斯普林菲爾德小鎮，

cues.text: Oregon.
cues.en: Oregon.
cues.zh: 俄勒岡州。

cues.text: And if we look at Homer's salary there it places him pretty comfortably in the lower
cues.en: And if we look at Homer's salary there it places him pretty comfortably in the lower
cues.zh: 如果我們看看荷馬在那裡的薪水，他在較低的薪水中相當舒適

cues.text: middle class income bracket.
cues.en: middle class income bracket.
cues.zh: 中產階級收入階層。

cues.text: Of course, this is all based on one job as a safety inspector at the Springfield Nuclear
cues.en: Of course, this is all based on one job as a safety inspector at the Springfield Nuclear
cues.zh: 當然，這一切都是基於斯普林菲爾德核電廠安全檢查員的工作。

cues.text: Power Plant.
cues.en: Power Plant.
cues.zh: 發電廠。

cues.text: But Homer has had over 191 jobs in 27 seasons and they’ve placed him across the entire
cues.en: But Homer has had over 191 jobs in 27 seasons and they’ve placed him across the entire

cues.text: economic spectrum.
cues.en: economic spectrum.
cues.zh: 經濟範圍。

cues.text: You know, I've had a lot of jobs.
cues.en: You know, I've had a lot of jobs.
cues.zh: 你知道，我做過很多工作。

cues.text: Boxer, mascot, astronaut, imitation Krusty, baby proofer, trucker, hippie, plow driver,
cues.en: Boxer, mascot, astronaut, imitation Krusty, baby proofer, trucker, hippie, plow driver,
cues.zh: 拳擊手、吉祥物、太空人、仿Krusty、嬰兒打樣機、卡車司機、嬉皮、犁車司機、

cues.text: food critic, conceptual artist, grease salesman, carnie, mayor, grifter, bodyguard for the
cues.en: food critic, conceptual artist, grease salesman, carnie, mayor, grifter, bodyguard for the
cues.zh: 美食評論家、概念藝術家、油脂推銷員、卡尼、市長、騙子、保鑣

cues.text: mayor, garbage commissioner, mountain climber, farmer, inventor, Smithers, Poochie, celebrity
cues.en: mayor, garbage commissioner, mountain climber, farmer, inventor, Smithers, Poochie, celebrity
cues.zh: 市長、垃圾專員、登山家、農民、發明家、史密瑟斯、普奇、名人

cues.text: assistant, power plant worker, fortune cookie writer, beer baron, Kwik-E Mart clerk, homophobe
cues.en: assistant, power plant worker, fortune cookie writer, beer baron, Kwik-E Mart clerk, homophobe

cues.text: and missionary.
cues.en: and missionary.
cues.zh: 和傳教士。

cues.text: But protecting Springfield, that gives me the best feeling of all.
cues.en: But protecting Springfield, that gives me the best feeling of all.
cues.zh: 但保護斯普林菲爾德給了我最好的感覺。

cues.text: Some of these jobs were literally impossible to determine salaries for — like “beer
cues.en: Some of these jobs were literally impossible to determine salaries for — like “beer
cues.zh: 其中一些工作實際上是不可能確定工資的——比如“啤酒”

cues.text: smuggler,” or “the grim reaper.” There were also some seasonal jobs (“mall santa”), and those had to be excluded.
cues.en: smuggler,” or “the grim reaper.” There were also some seasonal jobs (“mall santa”), and those had to be excluded.
cues.zh: 走私者」或「死神」。還有一些季節性工作（「商場聖誕老人」），這些工作必須被排除在外。

cues.text: In the end, I narrowed Homer’s resume down to 100 jobs, then looked up the average salary
cues.en: In the end, I narrowed Homer’s resume down to 100 jobs, then looked up the average salary
cues.zh: 最後，我將 Homer 的履歷縮小到 100 個職位，然後查了平均薪資

cues.text: for each one.
cues.en: for each one.
cues.zh: 對於每一個。

cues.text: Here’s what we found.
cues.en: Here’s what we found.
cues.zh: 這是我們發現的。

cues.text: Three of Homer’s 10 highest-paying jobs have been at the power plant.
cues.en: Three of Homer’s 10 highest-paying jobs have been at the power plant.
cues.zh: 荷馬的 10 個收入最高的工作中有 3 個是在發電廠。

cues.text: In season 13, he tried his hand as the plant’s executive VP before momentarily taking over
cues.en: In season 13, he tried his hand as the plant’s executive VP before momentarily taking over
cues.zh: 在第 13 季中，他嘗試擔任工廠的執行副總裁，然後暫時接任

cues.text: Mr. Burns’s post as CEO the following season.
cues.en: Mr. Burns’s post as CEO the following season.
cues.zh: 伯恩斯先生在下一季擔任執行長。

cues.text: Dad please you're the head of a major corporation.
cues.en: Dad please you're the head of a major corporation.
cues.zh: 爸爸，拜託你是大公司的負責人。

cues.text: You're right.
cues.en: You're right.
cues.zh: 你說得對。

cues.text: Three years later, he served as the facility’s manager.
cues.en: Three years later, he served as the facility’s manager.
cues.zh: 三年後，他擔任該設施的經理。

cues.text: Dohhhhhhhhh.
cues.en: Dohhhhhhhhh.
cues.zh: 呵呵呵。

cues.text: Uhhhmmmm.
cues.en: Uhhhmmmm.
cues.zh: 呃嗯嗯。

cues.text: Uhhhh.
cues.en: Uhhhh.
cues.zh: 呃呃。

cues.text: Duhhhhhhh.
cues.en: Duhhhhhhh.
cues.zh: 呵呵。

cues.text: Around half of Homer’s jobs place him in the middle class.
cues.en: Around half of Homer’s jobs place him in the middle class.
cues.zh: 荷馬大約一半的工作使他屬於中產階級。

cues.text: And his least lucrative jobs were pretty odd.
cues.en: And his least lucrative jobs were pretty odd.
cues.zh: 他最不賺錢的工作也很奇怪。

cues.text: He was a mascot, a carny, moonshine taste tester, a cannonball performance artist, and
cues.en: He was a mascot, a carny, moonshine taste tester, a cannonball performance artist, and
cues.zh: 他是吉祥物、肉食、私酒味覺測試員、砲彈表演藝術家，

cues.text: a walking billboard.
cues.en: a walking billboard.
cues.zh: 行走的廣告牌

cues.text: What are those doing there?!
cues.en: What are those doing there?!
cues.zh: 那些人在那裡做什麼？

cues.text: Earning us a hundred bucks a week that's what.
cues.en: Earning us a hundred bucks a week that's what.
cues.zh: 每週賺一百美元就是這樣。

cues.text: I plotted out Homer’s hypothetical job salaries in a linear order, by episode number.
cues.en: I plotted out Homer’s hypothetical job salaries in a linear order, by episode number.
cues.zh: 我按照劇集編號以線性順序繪製了荷馬的假設工作薪水。

cues.text: And over the course of 597 episodes — from 1989 to 2016 — it’s clear that he hasn’t
cues.en: And over the course of 597 episodes — from 1989 to 2016 — it’s clear that he hasn’t
cues.zh: 從 1989 年到 2016 年的 597 集中，很明顯他並沒有

cues.text: really ascended economically.
cues.en: really ascended economically.
cues.zh: 經濟上確實提升了。

cues.text: Estelle: Despite a few successes here and there, he has stagnated and that makes him
cues.en: Estelle: Despite a few successes here and there, he has stagnated and that makes him
cues.zh: 艾斯特：儘管在這裡或那裡取得了一些成功，但他已經停滯不前，這使他

cues.text: just like the actual American middle class.
cues.en: just like the actual American middle class.
cues.zh: 就像真正的美國中產階級一樣。

cues.text: Until the 1970s, the income of the average American family grew alongside national economic
cues.en: Until the 1970s, the income of the average American family grew alongside national economic
cues.zh: 直到 1970 年代，美國家庭的平均收入隨著國家經濟的成長而成長

cues.text: productivity.
cues.en: productivity.
cues.zh: 生產率。

cues.text: Since then, wages have stagnated, and have failed to keep up with inflation.
cues.en: Since then, wages have stagnated, and have failed to keep up with inflation.
cues.zh: 從那時起，薪資停滯不前，未能跟上通貨膨脹的步伐。

cues.text: Economists refer to this as the ‘middle-class squeeze’.
cues.en: Economists refer to this as the ‘middle-class squeeze’.
cues.zh: 經濟學家稱此為「中產階級擠壓」。

cues.text: Homer’s median income has never surpassed the median income in the United States.
cues.en: Homer’s median income has never surpassed the median income in the United States.
cues.zh: 荷馬的收入中位數從未超過美國的收入中位數。

cues.text: Despite brief forays into the 1 percent, Homer remains a paradigm of middle-class America:
cues.en: Despite brief forays into the 1 percent, Homer remains a paradigm of middle-class America:
cues.zh: 儘管荷馬短暫涉足了 1%，但他仍然是美國中產階級的典範：

cues.text: Three decades later, he’s right where he started.
cues.en: Three decades later, he’s right where he started.
cues.zh: 三十年後，他又回到了起點。
